title.narrative: Siamang Conservation in Bukit Barisan Selatan National Park

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to protect the habitat of siamang populations in BBSNP, with benefits provided to agile gibbon populations, and reduce the illegal domestic trade in apes. The following objectives and associated activities will be accomplished: (1) Prevent habitat loss for siamang and agile gibbon through patrols with park rangers, particularly targeting areas in the vicinity of roads under high threat of deforestation by conducting SMART (Spatial Monitoring and Reporting Tool) patrols in priority siamang and agile gibbon habitat in BBSNP; (2) Support BBSNP management planning for siamang and agile gibbon conservation through enhanced research, by (a) developing a high-quality conservation research training syllabus and providing training in its modules, and (b) supporting BBSNP technicians and Indonesian students to carryout necessary research to inform conservation action for siamang and agile gibbon populations; (3) Reduce trafficking of ape species through targeting the principal networks of online traders and bird markets in Jakarta, by (a) compiling and tracking information on the domestic trade of apes in Indonesia, and (b) providing actionable illegal ape trade information to law enforcement agency partners.
